newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pacific signs HK$12.5 bln club loan.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pacific signs HK$12.5 bln club loan.

text.p: CITIC Pacific has signed a HK$12.5 billion bridge loan with five banks to help finance its acquisition of China Light & Power Co shares, CITIC Pacific said on Tuesday.

Hong Kong Bank, J.P. Morgan, Hang Seng Bank, Chase Manhattan Bank and Banque Nationale de Paris each contributed HK$2.5 billion. The transaction was completed as a club deal and will not be generally syndicated.
The short-term facility has a tenor of less than one year.
A CITIC Pacific executive said the company currently is considering ways to raise longer-term financing to fund the China Light & Power purchase, but declined to give further details.
CITIC Pacific in January announced that it would buy 497.66 million new shares, or 20 percent, of China Light & Power Co's enlarged share capital, at HK$32.66 per share.
At the time of the announcement, CITIC Pacific said it would fund the HK$16.25 billion purchase with internal resources and bank borrowings.
